def ot_rand(state):
    tmpstate = 33614 * state
    q = tmpstate & 0xffffffff
    q = q >> 1
    p = tmpstate >> 32
    mlcg = p + q
    if mlcg & 0x80000000:
        mlcg &= 0x7fffffff
        mlcg += 1
    return mlcg

state = 1
vals = []
for i in range(20):
    state = ot_rand(state)
    vals.append(state)
print(vals)
print([v & 0xff for v in vals])
